gizmo.title: Yanayi mai rassa
gizmo.description: Labari inda kowane zaɓi ke kai wa fage da ƙarshe daban. Masu koyo za su iya komawa baya su gwada wasu hanyoyi; ƙarshen da aka kai shi ne ke saita maki.

configure.title: Take
configure.description: Sunan yanayin, ana nuna shi a kansa.

configure.title: Fagen farawa
configure.description: Id na fagen da masu koyo ke farawa da shi. Bar shi babu komai don farawa da fage na farko.

advanced.title: Launin ƙawa
advanced.description: Launi na zaɓi don guntun kai, maɓallai da gefen zaɓi.
